meta.title: The Dinosaur Hall
meta.textType: facts and pictures: yes or no

paragraphs: On Saturday morning, the Explorers visited the science museum. Guide Ann met them at the front door. The museum was big and quiet. "Today we will go to the dinosaur hall," she said. "No one goes in without a ticket, so please show yours." The children walked in a line behind her. In the middle of the hall stood a very big dinosaur. Leo and Mia stood very close to it. The air in the hall was cool, and the children were quiet.

A big board stood next to the dinosaur. It said: "This dinosaur lived on land many millions of years ago. It was as long as a bus. It ate meat, and its teeth were large. It breathed air, like people and dogs. People found its bones in the ground." The bones were gray and very old.

Guide Ann smiled at the children. "Dinosaurs lived long before people," she said. "Some dinosaurs were as small as a chicken." "Many of them ate plants, but today all dinosaurs are extinct." Then she let each child touch a model of a dinosaur egg. "It is hard and cold," said Mia. "Baby dinosaurs came out of eggs," said Guide Ann.

At the end of the hall, there was a board with a game. "True or false? One: Dinosaurs lived with people. Two: Some dinosaurs ate meat. Three: Dinosaurs breathed air." "One is false," said May. "Two and three are true."

The exit of the hall was next to the board. Mia took a photo of the dinosaur with her camera. May wrote three new things on a piece of paper. Everyone liked the game. "Will we come back?" asked Leo. "Yes, we will," said Guide Ann. "Next month, there is a new film about the sea." Leo drew the big dinosaur for Explorers' Blog.
text.summary: The Explorers visit the dinosaur hall at the science museum with Guide Ann. They read a sign, learn facts about a big dinosaur, and play a game of true or false.
